reviews.title: Great for Solo. Needs work for Multi
reviews.text:
I’ve really been loving this app in its solo form. I like that projects can be grouped by journeys and then reviewed. I love the data aspect as well where you can review what you’ve spent the most time on and the fact that when you go to say what you’re working on, it has options based off of previous tasks. 

I wish for the “co-op” piece, you weren’t limited on time and could set a pomodoro timer and also had the option to switch tasks without ending the session. I’ve had issues where the person I’m working with gets booted even though we’re still working. If that were resolved, it’d be five stars for me

reviews.title: Simple and workable
reviews.text: I’ve been downloading so many study timer and tracker apps 😭. This one came out on top! You can see day to year progress without paying and set timers or have a stopwatch running. My only problem is that the pomodoro timer, the creation of new journals, and deletion of sessions are all behind a paywall. However, the app is still useful without these features and the developer needs to profit somehow so it’s understandable!

reviews.title: Backgrounds
reviews.text: I like the design of the backgrounds. The way it moves is so mesmerizing and the music is so soft I could sleep to it.

reviews.title: Feature request
reviews.text:
Love the app. Just one thing I would love if it could eventually be included in the app. 

When I think of “journeys” I think of them as trying to achieve a specific goal, ex: “read xyz book”. 

I would love if a customizable to do list to complete the journey could be incorporated. Ex: read chapter 1, read chapter 2, etc.. and once you complete the entire to do list you reach the summit.

Best Regards, 
Venti

reviews.title: Focus Together, Anywhere in the World!
reviews.text:
I really love Focus Traveller. It genuinely helps me stay focused, and the whole idea of turning a focus session into a journey makes working or studying feel much more enjoyable. The design, atmosphere, and feeling of progressing on a journey are what make this app different from a normal focus timer.

I have one feature request that I think could make Focus Traveller even more powerful and popular: a way to discover and focus with other real users around the world, even if we don't already know them.

For example, in Multi mode, it would be amazing to see other travellers who are currently focusing, such as:

• Where their virtual journey is going (for example, Tokyo → New York)
• How long their journey is
• How long they have already been focusing
• How much time they have left
• Their country or region
• How many other travellers are currently focusing

It would be even better if we could join a random traveller or be automatically matched with someone who is starting a similar-length focus session. There could also be an option to create or join an open Travel Group with other users, not just friends.

A global and country leaderboard would also be amazing. Seeing who has completed the most focus time, longest journeys, or most consistent journeys could make the experience much more motivating and fun.

And if I find a traveller whose focus style I like, I would love to follow or save them as a favorite so I could join them again later.

Basically, I would love to feel like I'm not focusing alone — I'm part of a whole world of people traveling and getting things done together. 😊

I think this could take the already beautiful Focus Traveller concept to another level and make the app even more engaging, social, and motivating. Together, we get things done! ❤️

reviews.title: Great app, but…
reviews.text: I use this for work and really think it helps me focus but there is one issue I have with it. There needs to be a better notification system separate from the “focus music”. I often listen to podcasts on when using focus traveler and I have to turn off the focus music but when my rest time is up the fire sound starts and the only way to turn it off is to completely turn off focus music which then fails to notify me once my break is up. The two need to be separate. I want to be notified when my break is up but not have to have the fire sound going at the same time. I would like to be able to disable focus music and still receive notifications.

reviews.title: Please have whitelist feature
reviews.text:
Dear Focus Traveller Developers,

Thank you for creating such an amazing app! I truly enjoy using it!
However, one issue has been preventing me from using it consistently: I cannot find the "whitelist app" feature. As a PA student, I spend a significant portion of my study time using Anki and Quizlet, so this feature is very important for me.

If this feature is not currently available, I would sincerely appreciate it if you could consider adding it in the future. 

If it does exist, could you please let me know where I can find it in the settings?
Thank you so much for your help!
Best regards,

reviews.title: Really enjoy it! But some suggestions
reviews.text:
My husband and I really enjoy Focus Traveller so far - the graphics and music are beautiful and make it a great environment for staying focused. Looking forward to seeing more creative options in the future!

One suggestion that would greatly improve the experience of giving users the option to prevent the screen from dimming during a session. It would be much more user-friendly to glance at the remaining time without needing to tap the screen.

Also noticed some minor syncing inconsistencies across multiple devices - would love to see more reliable account/data synchronization.

Overall, a very promising app with a lot of potential!

reviews.title: Great study tool!

I love the calmness of the app and all of the different options of music choices, scenes, characters, etc. I also switch back and forth between the Pomodoro study schedule, set focus times, or the forever focus and using breaks as needed. I would recommend this app to anyone who is looking for a way to quiet the outside noise and have really good focus sessions!

It’s a small thing, but it does happen on occasion, and when it does, you have to end your session early just to get back on the trail.

Otherwise, this is a really great app and super helpful!
